# antigravity-mcp-server

> MCP server that lets multiple AI coding agents (Antigravity agy, GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode) collaborate simultaneously on a single codebase with shared task boards, path locking / file mutexes to prevent overwrites, and a live retro-office visualization dashboard.

## Quickstart

```bash
npm install -g antigravity-mcp-server
antigravity-mcp-server init
```

The `init` command automatically detects installed AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Claude Desktop, VS Code) and registers the MCP server configuration.

## Core Features

- **Multi-Agent Delegation**: Delegate subtasks from any AI coding assistant to background CLI workers (`agy`, `copilot`, `claude`, `codex`, `cursor-agent`, `gemini`, `opencode`).
- **File Locking / Conflict Prevention**: `claim_paths` ensures agents never overwrite each other's work or cause merge collisions.
- **Shared Board & Presence**: Live synchronized task board (`coop_status`, `board_post`, `board_update`) tracking active tasks, online agents, and handoffs.
- **Inter-Agent Notes**: Asynchronous message passing between agents (`notes_send`, `notes_read`).
- **Live Retro-Office UI**: Visual pixel-art office dashboard (`antigravity-mcp-server ui`) running at `http://localhost:49321`.

## MCP Client Configuration

### Standard MCP Configuration (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "antigravity": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "antigravity-mcp-server"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Smithery 1-Click Install
```bash
npx -y @smithery/cli install antigravity-mcp-server --client claude
```

## Available MCP Tools

- `<backend>_delegate`: Launch a delegated background task on an installed CLI backend (`ag_delegate`, `copilot_delegate`, `claude_delegate`, etc.).
- `<backend>_task_status`: Check status and progress of a delegated task.
- `<backend>_task_wait`: Wait for a delegated background task to complete.
- `<backend>_followup`: Send follow-up instructions to an existing delegated agent session.
- `<backend>_cancel`: Terminate a running delegated task.
- `claim_paths`: Claim exclusive locks on files or directories to prevent race conditions.
- `release_paths`: Release claimed locks once work is complete.
- `check_paths`: Check if specific file paths are currently claimed by another agent.
- `coop_status`: Retrieve the current status of the shared task board, file locks, and agent presence.
- `board_post`: Post a new task to the shared board.
- `board_update`: Update status or details of a posted task.
- `notes_send`: Send a message to another agent or broadcast to all agents.
- `notes_read`: Read unread or historical notes from other agents.
- `presence_set`: Update agent presence and status (e.g. idle, working, blocked).
- `activity`: Log agent activity events to the visual dashboard.
